# Caraway Home’s 3PL collaboration drives parcel savings, returns benefits

Supply Chain Dive·

July 31, 2026

Home goods brand Caraway Home has partnered with ITS Logistics to scale its omnichannel distribution operations, achieving a 280% volume increase in a single year. By implementing a live rate-shopping tool and a custom reverse logistics workflow, the company reduced parcel costs by 20% while improving its sustainability profile through strategic product recovery. This collaboration highlights the importance of flexible 3PL partnerships for young brands navigating the complexities of wholesale and e-commerce expansion.

Caraway Home and ITS Logistics have developed a suite of digital tools to manage the brand's rapid transition into omnichannel retail. Central to this effort is a live rate-shopping tool that replaced static, weight-based shipping rules with real-time optimization across a network of regional and national parcel carriers. # Wegmans invests $110 million in supply chain expansion

The company said there will be no layoffs tied to the changes and that it will work with affected employees throughout the transition.

 , and Thorvardur de Shong 

 September 21, 2026 . 3:32 PM 

 

ROCHESTER, N.Y. — Wegmans Food Markets is investing $110 million in its supply chain network, including new facilities in Rochester and the consolidation of certain distribution operations, as the retailer builds capacity for future growth.

The investment includes a new refrigerated facility in Rochester to support Wegmans’ perishable operations, including fresh produce, meat and seafood, and deli and restaurant foods. The grocer also plans to relocate its return center operations from Winton Road to a new, modernized facility in Rochester.

Wegmans said the projects are intended to increase capacity, improve working conditions for employees, enhance service to stores, and reduce the company’s reliance on third-party providers. Planning is underway, but construction and opening timelines for the new Rochester facilities have not yet been finalized.

# White Cap Strengthens Northeast Supply Chain with New Distribution Center

By Enterprise Viewpoint

 

The company’s latest investment expands delivery capacity, improves inventory availability, and helps contractors receive construction supplies faster across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic

Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, 7 August 2026 – White Cap has taken another major step in strengthening its supply chain by opening its second Enterprise Distribution Center in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania. The new facility marks the company’s first large-scale distribution hub in the eastern United States and reflects its continued focus on improving service for construction professionals. The center adds nearly 481,000 square feet of distribution space and is expected to play a key role in supporting customers across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic regions.

 Keurig Dr Pepper was named winner of the 2021 Food Engineering Plant of the Year for its production facility and regional distribution center in Allentown, Pa. Photos courtesy of Keurig Dr Pepper 

September 1, 2026

Chobani plans to invest approximately $1.2 billion over the next five years in a 1.5 million-sq.-ft. manufacturing and warehouse campus in Allentown, Pennsylvania, creating more than 900 jobs and establishing a major new hub for the company's growth.

As part of an expanded partnership with Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP), Chobani will acquire its Allentown manufacturing facility and warehouse, including its equipment and related infrastructure. First opened for production in 2021, the facility provides a starting point for Chobani to build on with new equipment, technology and production capabilities. # Do it Best Group to Close Montgomery Distribution Center, Shift Volume to Wilkes-Barre

 Doug Donaldson September 1, 2026 Industry News 

Do it Best Group will cease operations at its Montgomery, New York, distribution center in the second quarter of 2027, shifting the facility’s volume to the company’s 1.4 million-square-foot distribution center in Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania.

The company announced the move Sept. 1 as part of its continuing integration of the Do it Best and True Value distribution networks following Do it Best’s acquisition of True Value.
